- Read `.github/copilot-instructions.md` before acting.
- Delegate independent review to Claude Code only, and only through the checked-in review script (`scripts/agent-review.ps1`). As of 2026-09-18 (MISSION 1) it drives a FIVE-STAGE ROLE PIPELINE in declaration order — `plan` → `code` → `security` → `ux` → `e2e` — and stops at the first stage that exits non-zero (제14장). Group selectors: `all` (default), `review` (the four read-only lenses), `both` (the legacy security+ux pair). Every stage is the one governing agent reading a different charter under `.github/agents/`; those charters are the single source of the criteria and `scripts/sync-codex.mjs` discovers them by glob, so a new role is gated against doctrine drift automatically. A lens is a perspective, not an agent integration — Gemini and every other auxiliary agent CLI were destroyed on 2026-09-17 under 제4장, and re-introducing one is a constitutional violation, not a tooling choice.
- Frontend work obeys 제12장 (U-Square 하이퍼-테마 생태계 및 제로-프릭션 UI/UX), which as of v49.0 raises IMPECCABLE TASTE from a docs doctrine to constitutional law — AI-default flat styling is permanently banned, micro-interactions·글래스모피즘·1픽셀 오차 0 타이포그래피는 강제이며, 전 세계 디자인 트렌드를 자율 분석해 스스로 미학적 판단을 내린다. Its mechanical rules live in `docs/process/IMPECCABLE_TASTE.md` (bound by `CLAUDE.md` §0 부록-B): the containing-block ban on `html`/`body`/`.dashboard-zoom`, `backdrop-filter` capped at `#unitas-nav` plus one modal backdrop, and new motion referencing `--qw-ease` / `--qw-dur*` rather than fresh literals. Where a general design skill contradicts it, the doctrine wins.
- Keep all secrets in environment variables or GitHub Actions secrets.
- Treat `config/modules.json` as the source of truth for revenue pages.
- Run `npm run build:pages`, `npm test`, and the relevant deployment validation before reporting completion.
- Never deploy when required secrets are placeholders.
- Do not modify generated files by hand; modify the catalog or generator instead.
